label: TP
reason: User input from request parameter flows directly to bar via substring(0, length-1), which removes only the last character. Since XSS payloads require specific characters (like </script>) that may appear anywhere in the input, truncating the last character is insufficient sanitization. An attacker can craft input where the malicious payload remains intact after truncation, allowing it to reach the HTML sink.

evidence.note: param flows to bar via substring(0,length-1) then to charArray sink; truncation is bypassable
